tldr: Mars in Gemini: action moves through words, ideas, and quick adaptation.
body: With Mars in Gemini, drive is mental, verbal, and restless. You act by asking, debating, learning, and keeping options moving.
gift: Fast thinking, tactical flexibility, persuasive speech, and mental courage.
challenge: Scattered energy, argument for argument's sake, and starting more than you finish.
note: Authored from Marie Satori planet-through-sign material.
